title: Home practical guide and safety card: conduction spoons
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 38 (Home practical guide and safety card: conduction spoons (portal worksheet; adult pours, mug on a tray))
intro: Lesson 38: Conduction. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To compare how well different spoons conduct heat
equipment: Butter and small beads or peas
safety: Adult pours, mug on a tray
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Stick a bead with butter at the same height on each spoon
Stand the spoons in the mug on a tray
An adult pours in hot water
Rank the spoons from best to worst conductor

head: Spoon
Time for the bead to fall (s)

questions.q: Big question: why does the metal bench feel colder?
questions.a: Metal conducts energy away from your hand faster.
